detail: variant policy that lets the guest SEE the relay (guest->relay tcp/9999 only): box3 routes via tailscale0, tailscale ping works (direct, 1 ms), tcp/9999 answered by box1 (connection refused = packet admitted, nothing listening), tcp/60000 and tcp/22 time out = dropped by the tailnet packet filter on the receiving node. So enforcement is both peer invisibility and per-port filtering
